clue.text: Drivel introducing your useless old document

indicators.note: the drivel comes first and leads in the pieces that follow it

parts.note: pap is soft mushy food, hence worthless talk or drivel
US is an informal short form of useless, as in 'it's no us'

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a pointless old paper full of rubbish addressed to you.
explanation.definitionFit: Papyrus is an ancient writing material, and by extension a manuscript written on it.

clue.text: Personal secretary with bit of cloth on appears as model

parts.note: PA is personal assistant, a personal secretary
a rag is a scrap of cloth
taken as written

explanation.surface: A PA arrives in a scrap of cloth and is still held up as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragon is a model of excellence, a perfect example.

clue.text: Money set aside from new pound fines, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Fines paid in sterling might be saved up for someone's retirement.
explanation.definitionFit: A pension fund is money put aside to pay retirement income.

clue.text: Agitate very loudly, impeding government

indicators.note: the loud marking gets in the way by standing in the middle of the government word

parts.note: rule is government or control
FF is fortissimo, the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: A protester stirs things up by shouting at the authorities and getting in their way.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruffle someone is to disturb or fluster them.

clue.text: Quarrel with companion, mate game for getting heated?

parts.note: a spat is a petty quarrel
CH is Companion of Honour, a British order
cock is British slang for mate, a friend

explanation.surface: A row with a friend over a game turns into a heated contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' is not a contest here but game birds: a spatchcock is a fowl split open and flattened for grilling.
explanation.definitionFit: A spatchcocked fowl is game split down the back so it can be cooked quickly.

clue.text: Notice number on that back door

parts.note: a poster is a printed notice put up in public

explanation.surface: A sign announcing a number has been fixed to a rear entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A postern is a small rear or side gate in a castle or town wall.

clue.text: Stuff for a quid

definitions.meaning: to ... a hole is to stuff it
a quid is a lump of chewing tobacco

explanation.definitionFit: A plug is both a stopper rammed in and a cake of pressed tobacco.

clue.text: Craftsman one's wrong to associate with trash somehow?

indicators.note: one's wrong means the word one is put in the wrong order along with the rest

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

indicators.note: trash somehow means the letters of trash rearranged in some fashion

explanation.surface: It would be wrong to link a skilled cabinetmaker with rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'wrong' and the closing indicator ask for a rearrangement; together they mix ONE with TRASH into a single new word.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Sheraton was an 18th-century English furniture designer, a famous cabinet craftsman.

clue.text: One looks 27 maybe

definitions.meaning: the organ with which a person looks
the answer to 27 across, a globe, is a poetic word for this organ

explanation.definitionFit: The organ of sight is what does the looking, and poets call it an orb.

clue.text: No way drink is an answer to all problems!

parts.note: taken as written
ST is street, a way
rum is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: Someone insists that drink is no cure for anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A nostrum is a quack remedy, a supposed cure-all.

clue.text: Manage career

definitions.meaning: to ... a business is to manage it
to career is to rush along at speed

explanation.definitionFit: Running covers both directing an enterprise and dashing headlong along.

clue.text: Easeful rest, relaxing with nothing special in prospect

indicators.note: relaxing loosens the letters of easeful rest so they settle into a new order

explanation.surface: A lazy, untroubled break means nothing much lies ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without distinguishing marks offers no special feature, a bland outlook.

clue.text: In which good journey is curtailed by Strand?

definitions.text: In which good journey is curtailed by Strand?

indicators.note: curtailed means docked of its tail, so the final letter goes

parts.note: a ride is a journey in a vehicle
a lock is a strand of hair

explanation.surface: A London motorist's trip along the Strand is cut short by traffic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' drops the last letter of RIDE to leave RID. The Strand is a busy street in central London, which makes the whole clue a picture of a jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Total traffic jam, the kind in which any good trip along a London street is halted.

clue.text: Stir rock group's lead singer

parts.note: stir and can are both slang for prison
a tor is a rocky hill or outcrop, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Stirring up a rock band is its frontman.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantor leads the singing of a congregation or choir, a synagogue or church precentor.

clue.text: Call for retirement, after which employment ceases

definitions.meaning: the bugle call sounded at night to send soldiers to bed
the final job someone holds, after which they work no more

explanation.definitionFit: The bugle call ends the soldier's day, and a final appointment ends a working life.

clue.text: Rubbishing of negativism is designed to speed things up

indicators.note: rubbishing wrecks the word negativism so its letters can be rebuilt

explanation.surface: Dismissing pessimism is meant to get things moving faster.
explanation.definitionFit: A time-saving method reduces the time a task takes, so it speeds things up.

clue.text: What's left after taking all of sister's audio system?

indicators.note: an audio system is something heard, so the word for sister is taken by its sound

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister

explanation.surface: Someone takes every bit of a sister's stereo set, leaving nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Once everything has been taken, there is not a single one remaining.

clue.text: What may have disturbed her — demonic sea creature

indicators.note: disturbed puts the letters of her demonic out of order

explanation.surface: Something possessed and devilish seems to have upset a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges HERDEMONIC; 'What may have' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: Starfish and sea urchins belong to this phylum of spiny marine animals.

clue.text: English road running into a bleak Welsh town

indicators.note: the English road runs into the middle of the bleak word

parts.note: bleak and bare both describe an empty landscape

explanation.surface: An English road leads into a desolate town in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Aberdare is a town in the Cynon Valley in South Wales.

clue.text: Excruciatingly awful digital processor

parts.note: digital means to do with fingers, so this processes a digit in the most painful way

explanation.definitionFit: An old torture device that crushed fingers or thumbs, hence an agonising processor of digits.

clue.text: Horizontal support that is black, stuck in the side

indicators.note: the two pieces are pushed inside the side, stuck in it

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
ie is id est, that is
B is the pencil-grading abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A dark horizontal beam is wedged into the side of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie beam is a horizontal timber joining the feet of rafters in a roof.

clue.text: Catch one's breath and talk quietly

parts.note: to gas is to chatter idly
P is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone pauses for air and speaks softly.
explanation.definitionFit: To gasp is to draw in breath sharply, as in surprise.

clue.text: Butler making an appearance in lacklustre story

indicators.note: the Butler appears inside the lacklustre word

parts.note: pale means faint or lacklustre
Rab Butler was a British Conservative politician of the mid-20th century

explanation.surface: A butler turns up in a dull tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butler' looks like a servant, but it is R. A. 'Rab' Butler, the British politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A parable is a short story told to teach a moral lesson.

clue.text: Fellow able to' handle Big Bertha maybe

definitions.text: Fellow able to' handle Big Bertha maybe

parts.words: Fellow able to' handle Big Bertha maybe
parts.note: Big Bertha was a huge German siege howitzer of the First World War, so the person who handles it is an artilleryman

explanation.definitionFit: An artillery soldier operates big guns such as the famous Big Bertha howitzer.

clue.text: Bear close? Turn about!

parts.note: the close of something is its end
a U is a turn, as in U-turn
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Told to turn round at the end, someone grits their teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear something is to put up with it, a synonym of tolerate.

clue.text: Boast, having secured a post

indicators.note: the boasting word holds and encloses the A within it

parts.note: bluster is loud boastful talk

explanation.surface: A braggart lands a job and won't stop going on about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A baluster is one of the short pillars or posts supporting a handrail.

clue.text: Overlook someone who isn't married

definitions.meaning: to overlook something is to fail to notice it
the title used for an unmarried woman or girl

explanation.definitionFit: To miss is to overlook, and Miss is the title for an unmarried woman.

clue.text: Handing over offender — a custom no longer in force?

parts.note: ex means former, no longer current
a tradition is a custom handed down

explanation.surface: Surrendering a criminal to another country is an outdated practice.
explanation.definitionFit: Extradition is the formal surrender of an accused person to another state's jurisdiction.

clue.text: Fashion that bikers may aspire to?

definitions.meaning: a dated word for fashion or style
a hundred miles an hour, the speed motorcyclists try to reach

explanation.definitionFit: The word means fashionable style, and also a speed of one hundred mph for bikers.

clue.text: What's golden, associated with Head of Britain?

definitions.text: What's golden, associated with Head of Britain?

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Something golden goes with the British crown.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: the golden orb is part of the regalia held by the British monarch, the head of Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The orb is the golden globe carried by the sovereign as part of the crown jewels.

clue.text: Politeness with which married woman receives queen

indicators.note: the title takes the queen inside it, as a host receives a guest

parts.note: Mrs is the title of a married woman
Anne was a queen of Great Britain

explanation.surface: A wife shows good etiquette when the monarch comes to visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Good manners are courteous behaviour, the outward form of politeness.

clue.text: Facility to dispose of person's rubbish blocking entrance

indicators.note: the rubbish sits in the middle of the entrance, blocking it

parts.note: a gate is an entrance
rot is nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone's junk is piled up in the doorway of a waste facility.
explanation.definitionFit: A garotte is a cord or wire for strangling, a means of killing someone.
